bounded_attempt.sanitized_evidence: The official landing page identifies JESD270-4A, Release Number Version 1.1, published Dec 2025, and states that a free download requires registration or login. The original April 2025 JESD270-4 release is available through a public press-release syndication snapshot, but neither normative body was anonymously acquired.

blocker.claim_impact: Clause-level requirements, conformance conditions, physical/package compatibility, and changes from JESD270-4 to JESD270-4A cannot be verified. Original numeric claims must not be attributed to 4A without the body or a version-specific public source.
blocker.filesystem_posture: The original-version public release and current official landing-page snapshot are preserved with checksums; no restricted standard body is present.
blocker.recovery_route: Resume only if the user supplies an already-authorized copy of the relevant standard body or JEDEC offers anonymous public access; do not create an account.
blocker.resume_condition: An authorized JESD270-4 and/or JESD270-4A body becomes available for clause-level comparison.
usable_partial_evidence: JESD270-4 public-release claims dated 2025-04-16 may support release-level bandwidth, interface width, channel count, voltage options, DRFM, stack-height and die-density observations.

The current official landing page may support only JESD270-4A identity, release number, publication month, access posture, distributed independent-channel description, and 64-bit DDR channel-interface description.

summary: S09 的公开材料足以区分 JESD270-4 与当前 JESD270-4A，但两版规范正文均受注册或登录限制，无法完成条款级深读与版本差分。
title: v2 来源访问与版本限制：JESD270-4/4A
